statements.notes: Creatine is converted to phosphocreatine which is important for short energy bursts such as sprinting and weight lifting. Depletion of phosphocreatine can result in muscular fatigue and fading muscle power.
Tamper evident: Do not use this product if imprinted foil seal under cap is broken or missing.

Keep tightly closed.
Store at room temperature: 59 degrees - 86 degrees F (15 degrees - 30 degrees C).
Notice: This product is sold by weight and not by volume. You can be assured of proper weight even though some settling of contents may occur during shipping and handling.
Keep out of reach of children.
Caution: Creatine should be avoided by children, adolescents, pregnant women, nursing mothers or anyone at risk for renal disorders such as diabetics.
